en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, and from Sabaty, and from Zurara, from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, and they asked both of them<sup>asws</sup>

about buying a land of the farmers from taxation lands. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If it was that (rising of Al Qaim<sup>asws</sup>), it would be snatched away from you, or you would have to pay from it whatever from the taxes are upon it’.
Ammar said, ‘Then he<sup>asws</sup> faced me, so he<sup>asws</sup> said ;’Buy it, the right for you is what is more than that’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim from abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and from al-Sabatiy and from Zurarah who has said the following: “This is regarding their question before one of the two Imam, (abu Ja’far or abu ‘Abd Allah), ‘Alayhim al-Salam,

about buying the land of farmers of al-Kharaj land. He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘On its coming (the time of the rise of al-Mahdiy with Divine Authority and Power) the land will be taken away or you pay what is due on it of al-Kharaj.’
‘Ammar has said that he (the Imam) then turned to me and said, “You can buy it because your right on it is more than that of others.’””
